svg.title: Bounded contexts and the gateway
svg.desc: The 26 routes are tagged with five bounded contexts (reader, search, verify, insights, knowledge), each declaring the tables it reads. SGGS_MODULES selects the contexts a process serves and readiness refuses a database missing any declared table. gateway/routes.json says per environment where /api goes; tools/gen_gateway.py generates the Vercel rewrites from the route table, and CI proves the routing with X-Service probes and the whole golden contract.

text.font-family: "Source Serif 4", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One codebase, five contexts: how a service runs a slice of it, and how routing is generated so it cannot drift
